artworks.label: Ceramic Mountain Mosaic
artworks.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE new original standalone square1024x1024 Glaze small-widget illustration for tessera-tempo. One compact original abstract ceramic relief representing a layered mountain landscape: three asymmetrical angular interlocking mountain peaks made of thick blue-grey/cobalt, burnt terracotta and warm golden-ochre tesserae, an ivory triangular snowcap on the largest peak, with a single curved slate-blue foreground ribbon at their feet. Visually coherent single mosaic landscape, clean modernist geometry, subtle rounded bevels, satin-glazed stoneware and tactile fine mineral grain. Match a warm chalk/navy/terracotta geometric ceramic collection. No sun disk or stars, no pictograms, no loose counting dots; this is a tactile crafted miniature relief, not a vector graphic. Whole subject centered, compact readable silhouette, generous18percent empty margins. Truly transparent empty background, alpha preserved; no opaque tile, floor, frame, border or collage. Pure illustration only: absolutely no text, lettering, numerals, dates, clocks, hands, dials, calendars, UI, logos or watermark. Entirely new art, never copy/crop/recolour an existing image.
artworks.processing: Resize entire original square to 1024x1024; WebP q90 method4; alpha preserved; no crop, recolour or subject edits.
artworks.visualReview: Reviewed against wallpaper and all current pure-art subjects; distinct subject, matching style/palette, no text or live-value imagery.
